summary: KIZILKAN PLAYER FAZ 5 (Final release) tested. BACKEND: 22/22 pytest tests pass — all 19 previous FAZ 2-4 tests still green + 3 NEW DVR tests. DVR flow (POST /api/dvr/schedule → GET /api/dvr/schedules?playlist_id=X → DELETE /api/dvr/schedule/{rec_id}) works end-to-end with generated 'rec-XXXX' IDs, status='scheduled', proper MongoDB _id exclusion (never leaks in create response or list response), and delete verified via subsequent GET. FRONTEND FAZ 5 NEW: (1) Backup screen /backup renders correctly with the new Google Drive card and 'Yükle' button (testID drive-upload-btn). Clicking drive-upload-btn (with EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID unset) triggers authenticateGoogleDrive() which surfaces the EXPECTED Turkish error 'Google Drive henüz yapılandırılmadı. Uygulamayı Publish edip, Deployment paneli → Secrets bölümünden EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID değerini ekleyin.' via backup-msg banner. No red-screen crash, graceful degradation confirmed. (2) Player Record button (player-record-btn) present in bottom bar for non-synthetic streams — code verified at /app/frontend/app/player.tsx:318. It builds a DVR payload (playlist_id, channel_id, channel_name, ISO timestamps, title) and calls api.dvrSchedule. Backend endpoint confirmed working via direct curl (returns success + recording{id, status='scheduled'}). (3) TV Focus outlines: useTVFocus hook (/app/frontend/src/hooks/useTVFocus.ts) provides isFocused state + focusStyle(color, isFocused, radius) that applies borderColor+borderWidth=3 + shadow + transform:scale(1.04) when focused. ChannelRow.tsx:41,49,50,57 and PosterGrid.tsx PosterCard 58,63,64,67 both wire onFocus/onBlur handlers and apply focusStyle with colors.brandPrimary (red). FRONTEND REGRESSION: Onboarding still shows big KIZILKAN logo + '★ PLAYER ★' subtitle + 'Oynatma Listesi Ekle' primary CTA. Add-playlist modal renders 4 source-type chips (M3U URL / M3U Dosya / Xtream / MAG) + list-name/M3U-URL inputs + 'Demo listeyi kullan (iptv-org TR)' quick link + 'Kaydet ve Yükle' submit. NO red-screen crashes observed. NO new console errors beyond pre-existing react-native-web warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, useNativeDriver — carry-forward from FAZ 1-4). All Turkish text preserved.

ui_bugs.issue: Record button (Kaydet) calls api.dvrSchedule successfully but provides NO user feedback on success or failure — no toast, banner, or state change. Users cannot know whether the recording was scheduled. The catch block is empty (`catch {}`) and success also silently returns. Reference: /app/frontend/app/player.tsx:321-337.

react_native_issues.issue: Console emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'textShadow* is deprecated' warnings. These originate from Expo Router / vector-icons on react-native-web. Non-blocking, no code owned by this project.
Web preview shows 'useNativeDriver is not supported ... RCTAnimation module missing' warning. Expected on web — no functional impact. Native builds will use RCTAnimation.

action_items: MEDIUM: In /app/frontend/app/player.tsx around line 321-337, wire success/error feedback for the record button. Suggest a lightweight Toast or set a state like `recordMsg` and display it briefly as a chip in the top bar (e.g., 'Kayıt planlandı: 60 dk'). Currently users tap Kaydet and get zero confirmation, which will be reported as a bug post-launch.
OPTIONAL (carry-forward from FAZ 4): Add TextInput wired to `search` state in multi-view.tsx picker modal, OR remove dead search state.
OPTIONAL (carry-forward): silence react-native-web shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/resizeMode/useNativeDriver deprecation warnings on web build.
OPTIONAL: server.py (~837 lines) now exceeds 700-line threshold. Split into modules (m3u.py / xtream.py / stalker.py / epg.py / dvr.py) as a hygiene refactor before FAZ 6.

For production Google Drive OAuth to actually authorise (not just fail gracefully), the user must Publish, then set EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in the Deployment → Secrets panel and add authorized redirect URIs in the Google Cloud Console. Currently the graceful-fail path is CORRECT and EXPECTED as the user requested scaffolding-only.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/dvr/schedule (lines 783-791): correctly generates id='rec-{uuid4()[:12]}' if not provided, stores created_at ISO, and returns {k: v for k, v in doc.items() if k != '_id'} — MongoDB _id excluded from response. Good.
server.py GET /api/dvr/schedules (lines 794-798): uses projection {'_id': 0} on find() cursor. _id can never leak. Good.

server.py DELETE /api/dvr/schedule/{rec_id} (lines 801-804): returns {success: True, deleted: N}. If rec_id not found returns deleted:0 with 200 (not 404). Acceptable for MVP but consider returning 404 when deleted==0.

useTVFocus.ts is clean (32 lines) — pure hook with useState + useCallback. focusStyle helper applies borderWidth=3, shadowColor, shadowOpacity=0.9, shadowRadius=12, elevation=12, transform:scale(1.04). Correct TV visual affordance.

googleDrive.ts uses expo-auth-session + expo-web-browser correctly with WebBrowser.maybeCompleteAuthSession(). isGoogleDriveConfigured() reads process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID lazily. authenticateGoogleDrive throws Turkish error when unconfigured — exactly the graceful-degradation path requested.

backup.tsx drive-upload-btn onPress correctly wraps authenticateGoogleDrive → uploadJsonToDrive in try/catch with setMsg feedback via backup-msg banner. Confirmed working end-to-end (unconfigured error path).
player.tsx player-record-btn (lines 316-339) only renders for non-synthetic channels (`!isSynthetic`). Uses dynamic import of api util. BUG: empty catch/no success handling — see ui_bugs.
api.ts dvrSchedule/dvrList/dvrDelete all correctly prefix /api and use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env, no hardcoded URLs.
All 19 previous backend endpoints still green after DVR addition — no regression.

success_rate.frontend: 100% verified for FAZ 5 additions (Backup drive-upload-btn end-to-end, focus outlines wired in code, player record-btn present + DVR API confirmed via curl). 1 MEDIUM cosmetic bug: record-btn provides no user feedback.

rca_of_issue: One MEDIUM bug: player-record-btn silently posts to /api/dvr/schedule with no UI feedback (success/error). Reproduction: enter Live TV → tap any channel → wait for player → tap 'Kaydet' in bottom bar. Backend receives the POST (verified via curl and backend logs) and records the schedule, but the UI shows nothing — no toast, no banner, no state change. RCA: in /app/frontend/app/player.tsx:321-337, both the try success path and the `catch {}` block do nothing observable to the user. Mitigation: add a local `const [recordFlash, setRecordFlash] = useState<string|null>(null);` and set it to 'Kayıt planlandı ✓' on success and to the error message on catch, auto-clearing after ~3s; render a small chip near the top bar when non-null. Alternatively, reuse the existing error overlay by creating a new info-severity variant.
